name: Pyaaz Kachori
instructions: 1. Prepare a stiff dough using flour, salt, and melted ghee, then let it rest for 30 minutes.
2. For the filling, sauté cumin, fennel, and coriander seeds in oil, then add ginger-green chili paste and asafoetida.
3. Add finely chopped onions and cook until translucent; stir in besan and cook until fragrant.
4. Add spice powders (turmeric, chili, garam masala, amchur) and salt; cook until the mixture dries out, then let it cool.
5. Divide dough into balls, flatten, and stuff with the onion mixture, sealing the edges properly.
6. Gently press the filled kachoris to flatten slightly.
7. Deep fry on low to medium heat until they turn golden brown and crispy on both sides.
description: Pyaaz Kachori is an iconic breakfast snack originating from Jodhpur, Rajasthan. It is celebrated for its perfect balance of spicy, sweet, and tangy flavors, often enjoyed as a street food staple during morning hours with a cup of hot masala chai.
